metadata.title: US financial/tech regulator jurisdiction map — the 'who regulates what' oversight backbone (+ the fragmentation that enables arbitrage)
metadata.frame: The recurring actors across this corpus (SEC, FDIC, Treasury, Federal Reserve, CFTC, FTC, OCC, CFPB, FinCEN, OFAC, FHFA, DOL, DOJ/SDNY, NIST) were each wired only via one-off enforcement edges. This overlay adds the STRUCTURAL jurisdiction backbone: which agency oversees which domain hub already in the graph. The point is not just completeness - the FRAGMENTATION itself (overlapping/ambiguous jurisdiction, esp. crypto SEC-vs-CFTC and bank Fed/OCC/FDIC/state) is the arbitrage surface actors exploit (regulatory-capture reads are labeled interpretation; statutory jurisdiction is fact).
metadata.grade: statutory jurisdiction = FACT; specific enforcement actions cited = FACT; 'capture/arbitrage' framing = labeled interpretation.
metadata.method: Agency enabling statutes + public enforcement records already cited elsewhere in the corpus (spec-crypto-enforcement-actors, macro-fdic, macro-cre-privatecredit, spec-palantir-surveillance/Fannie Mae, auto FTC v GM, Binance $4.3B DOJ/FinCEN/OFAC/CFTC resolution).
metadata.coverage_note: Not exhaustive: this overlay wires the recurring financial/tech/defense regulators to their domain hubs. Other agencies touch the corpus and can be added as their blocks are interconnected (e.g., FCC/telecom, EPA, FAA/Boeing, HHS/CDC, GAO/OMB oversight, PCAOB audit, State/GEC).

edges.notes: Fed supervises bank holding companies + sets monetary policy/capital (Basel III endgame); lender of last resort (fact).
OCC charters/supervises national banks + federal thrifts; its charter decisions (incl. crypto/fintech) are a jurisdictional battleground (fact).
CFPB has consumer-financial-protection authority over banks/nonbanks; its funding + scope are politically contested (2025-26 rollback) (fact).
FHFA is conservator/regulator of Fannie Mae + Freddie Mac (since 2008); Director Pulte drove the Fannie Mae x Palantir fraud-detection tie-up and floated release from conservatorship (fact).

DOL sets ERISA fiduciary rules for 401(k)s - the gate that a 2025 Executive Order pried open to let PRIVATE CREDIT/alts into retirement accounts (the retailization risk in macro-cre-privatecredit) (fact).
Treasury/OCC oversight of payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act; the stablecoin->Treasury-bill rail ties the fiscal trap to crypto (fact).
Treasury-chaired FSOC + OFR are (slowly) building the nonbank/private-credit systemic-risk metric; the datacenter-specific exposure is still not separately published (measurement gap) (fact).
SEC asserts securities jurisdiction over many tokens/exchanges (Coinbase, Ripple, Binance) - the SEC-vs-CFTC ambiguity is the core crypto arbitrage surface ('Project Crypto', #215) (fact).
CFTC treats BTC/ETH as commodities + brought/settled actions (part of Binance's $4.3B 2023 resolution alongside DOJ/FinCEN/OFAC); CLARITY Act would hand it the spot-market lead (fact).
FinCEN (Treasury) enforces the Bank Secrecy Act/AML - central to the Binance resolution and the SE-Asia scam/illicit-finance thread (fact).
FTC brings antitrust/consumer-protection actions across Big Tech (Meta monopolization case) + connected-car privacy (FTC v. GM) - the consumer/competition regulator of the AI/data cluster (fact).
NIST sets the technical standards (FIPS 203/204/205 PQC) the rest of the regulatory stack references - standards-body as a quiet chokepoint (fact).
NCUA charters/insures credit unions (NCUSIF = the FDIC analog for ~4,500 CUs) - the fragmented deposit-insurance/charter map (Fed/OCC/FDIC/NCUA/state) is itself an arbitrage surface (fact).

FASB sets GAAP - incl. the HELD-TO-MATURITY-at-amortized-cost rule that lets banks carry underwater bonds at cost (the self-marked bank-asset defect, macro-fdic) and fair-value vs equity-method marks (fact).

GAAP useful-life/depreciation rules are the knob behind the depreciation-trap (fin-ai-depreciation-debttrap): extending GPU useful life 3->6yr flatters profit while economic life is ~2-3yr (fact of the standard; the abuse read is graded).
Commerce/BIS licenses advanced-chip exports (the NVIDIA-to-China restrictions + the IGAA/RTE regime that gated Gulf access to restricted GPUs, fin-gulf) - the West's compute-denial lever (fact).
BIS entity list + Foreign Direct Product Rule are the US half of the two-sided chip-chokepoint war (China's REE/FDPR-style controls are the mirror) (fact).
ICE is a DHS component; DHS/ICE drive the Palantir ImmigrationOS + LexisNexis/Thomson-Reuters data-broker procurement (spec-palantir-surveillance, spec-auto-connected-surveillance) (fact).

The Department of Defense - renamed 'Department of War' by 2025 EO (secondary title; Secretary Pete Hegseth) - is the ~$1T/yr buyer of the primes; REE-gated (defense-rare-earth) (fact of rename + budget).
DoW is the customer for Palantir's Maven Smart System (~$1.3B ceiling) (fact).
DoW reassigned Army IVAS (~$22B) from Microsoft to Anduril (Feb 2026) (fact).
